newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 4.24 points to 6,931.62. PLDT's ADR inched up 25 cents to $60.
* The peso closed slightly lower at 26.343 to a dollar.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index slid 8.45 points to 3,301.98.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was lower at 10.51325 percent from 10.5625 percent.
* The stockbroking arm of Union Bank of Switzerland is advising a sell or avoid on a number of major local banking issues saying they are due for a correction (MANILA TIMES)

* The Philippine Stock Exchange says it is investigating the roller coaster movement of the stock prices of six listed companies - Atok Big Wedge Co, Itogon-Suyoc Mines, Acoje Holdings, Marsteel Consolidated Inc, Southseas Petroleum and RFC Inc. (PHILIPPINE STAR)

* The Phinma Group will take a minority 10 percent stake in the consortium of Benpres Holdings and French firm Lyonnaise des Eaux when it operates the west zone of the Manila water supply (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
* Cosmos Bottling Corp said it was not affected by the price war set by Coca-Cola Bottlers Philippines Inc and Pepsi-Cola Products Phils. Inc (BUSINESSWORLD)
* SM Prime Holdings Inc is scheduled to open the SM City Bacoor in the third quarter of this year (BULLETIN)
* First Abacus Financial Holdings Corp says its net income increased to 167 million pesos last year from 124 million pesos in 1995. (MANILA TIMES)
* Uniwide Holdings Inc says it posted a net income of 763 million pesos for 1996, up from 111.6 million in 1995. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)
